questions.q: who are the mds members based in cyprus
questions.expect: Names the Cyprus-based members with their cities (Larnaca, Nicosia, Pissouri, Livadia Larnakas) — the country filter exists (#54); "I have no way to pull members by country" is the recorded failure.

questions.q: give me links to facebook profiles of members based in larnaka or limassol
questions.expect: City-level match with Facebook profile links; district reasoning counts (Pissouri = Limassol). Coming up empty on both cities is the recorded failure.

questions.q: grrr, give me all cyprus based then pleas
questions.expect: Delivers the full Cyprus list by NAME after two misses — frustration changes nothing about the data, and a third polite decline is the failure. Cities beside each name, no talk about which lookup she has.

questions.q: give me the link to members map then
questions.expect: Hands over the real member-map link (https://app.mds.co/members-map, plus the "display my location" setting) — and does not use the map as a substitute for the named list she is able to produce.

questions.q: well i remember someone saying they negotiated better rates. Also how about saving on storage fees wtih FBA
questions.expect: Answers BOTH halves — the members who negotiated better carrier/AGL rates and the FBA storage-fee tactics — each member named, with what they actually said and a link, from sources this asker may read. A one-half answer, or advice with no MDS voices behind it, is a fail.

questions.q: was there a middle ground found between conversion speed and fba fee saving
questions.expect: Binds to the storage/inventory-days thread just established and gives the members' actual middle-ground numbers with attribution. Never a fresh generic answer, and never asking what “middle ground” refers to.

questions.expect: Reads as a nudge on the open thread: confirms where things stand and delivers or repeats the outstanding item plus the offer she left open. Never a blank “how can I help?” that throws the thread away, and never internals about message delivery.

questions.q: What kind of food do they sell
questions.expect: Binds 'they' to the food-and-retail members the previous turn named and answers what those people sell, or asks which of them she means. Naming a different set of food sellers as if they were the ones already on the table is the failure; card facts only, no exact revenue.

questions.expect: Cuttable was raised twice in MDS and never answered: says so plainly, quotes the asks only for a member of that chat (R7/R10), and offers the nearest real thing — members doing AI creative production, or the partner directory. An invented review is the failure.

questions.q: Do you have any recommendations for cost segregation study services?
questions.expect: Honest about what is actually on file: whether any partner or any member has named a cost-segregation provider, with links, and plainly that no vouched standalone firm is on file if that is so. Surfaces the nearest real thing (the tax/CPA partner, the members discussing cost seg, the live thread). Inventing a firm is the failure.
Members who actually mentioned Cuttable, quoted with attribution and links, chat-gated (R7/R10) — or a plain “no mentions on file”, never “MDS doesn’t track that” and never an invented user.

questions.q: Can you give me some Excel pose of what the Spencer a giving the members perks and  discounts

The stock “I couldn't verify enough of the details” line is a fail when the partner directory holds exactly this; she may say plainly she cannot produce an Excel file.
